name: Lambda 0.4 (uncertainty-heavy)
description: Shifts weight strongly toward uncertainty over mastery gap

name: Lambda 0.85 (mastery-heavy)
description: Shifts weight strongly toward mastery gap over uncertainty

description: Low threshold + soft gate k=1.0 — admits more candidates

name: Strict readiness gate
description: High threshold + soft gate k=2.2 — only well-ready concepts pass

name: Meta strength 0.3
description: Mild metacognitive signal — less influence than metacog_balanced

description: Aggressive metacognitive signal beyond metacog_strict range

name: No root penalty
description: Removes the penalty for root-node concepts

name: High root penalty 0.35
description: Strongly penalises root concepts to push toward deeper nodes

name: Early stop mastery 0.85
description: Retires concepts at 85% mastery instead of 99%

name: Tight readiness distance delta 0.6
description: Reduces the distance contribution to readiness scoring
